responsibility: Header defining the Objective-C front end’s lightweight identifier-to-tree map abstraction. It declares the GGC-managed backing structure, tuning API, and inline operations for lookup, insertion, and iteration over open-addressed hash tables, which are used throughout the ObjC semantic code to store mappings like selector, class-name, and protocol-name associations.
same_name_distinction: Header that defines the objc_map data structure and its inline API, including the private table layout, sentinel values, and inline operations for get/put and iteration. Unlike objc-map.cc, it is the includable definition layer used throughout the ObjC front end, not the out-of-line allocation/rehash implementation.
